input: Order a custom name stamp for my stationery

keyUnknowns.whyItMatters: The stamp could include just a name, or also an address, monogram, logo, or decorative elements — this changes what needs to be designed and ordered.
Whether this is for personal use, a business, or as a gift changes the tone, style, and details that go on the stamp.
Stamp style (self-inking, rubber with pad, embosser, wax seal) dramatically affects the product category to shop for and the final look.
Budget and delivery deadline determine which vendors and product tiers are realistic options.
Knowing what the stamp will go on (envelopes, notecards, packaging, kraft paper) affects the required ink type, stamp size, and impression surface.
The user may prioritise longevity, a specific aesthetic, a fast turnaround, or a particular impression size — this focuses the vendor search.
Whether the user wants help finding a vendor online, designing the artwork, or placing the order determines what the immediate next action should be.

gold.taskTitle: Order a custom name stamp for stationery
gold.taskDescription: The user wants to purchase a custom stamp featuring their name, to be used on personal stationery.

questions.title: What text or details should the stamp include?
questions.description: Clarify whether the stamp is name-only or also includes an address, title, monogram, or decorative border.

questions.title: Is this for personal use, business, or a gift?
questions.description: Understand who the stamp is for, which shapes the tone, style, and content of the design.

questions.title: What stamp type appeals to you — self-inking, rubber, embosser, or wax seal?
questions.description: Identify the preferred stamp mechanism, as each produces a different look and requires a different vendor.

questions.title: What is your budget for this stamp?
questions.description: Establish a price range to filter vendor and product options appropriately.

questions.title: What surfaces will you be stamping on most often?
questions.description: Knowing the target surface (envelopes, notecards, kraft wrap, etc.) informs the right ink type and stamp size.

questions.title: Is a fast delivery deadline important for this order?
questions.description: A required-by date narrows the vendor list to those who can meet turnaround expectations.

questions.title: Do you need help finding a vendor, designing artwork, or placing the order?
questions.description: Pinpoint which part of the process the user needs support with to identify the right next action.
